name: bbox-mcp-server
description: The geospatial toolkit for AI agents — query, route, elevate, convert, and verify spatial data with zero config. 11 tools for bounding boxes, coordinate projection, H3 indexing, OpenStreetMap Overpass queries, traffic control checks, OSRM routing, Copernicus DEM elevation, spatial geometry math, and shareable map verification links.

tools.name: get_bounds
tools.description: Get converted coordinates for a bounding box or natural-language location search (powered by Nominatim with configurable Photon & optional Mapbox fallbacks). Supports parsing WKT, GeoJSON, ogrinfo extent, Web Mercator tiles ('z/x/y'), single points ('lat,lng'), and raw coordinate strings, plus optional metric buffering.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'New York City', 'Central Park'). Uses OpenStreetMap Nominatim (or configurable NOMINATIM_API_URL / PHOTON_API_URL / optional MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), a single point ('lat,lng'), a Web Mercator tile ('z/x/y'), a WKT polygon/linestring/point, a GeoJSON payload, or an `ogrinfo` extent block. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

buffer_meters.description: Optional distance in meters to expand (positive) or shrink (negative) the bounding box in all directions. Ideal for creating a bounding box around a single point.

epsg.description: The projected EPSG code (e.g. '3857'). Defaults to '4326' (WGS84). Over 3,900 bundled projections; unknown codes are auto-fetched from epsg.io.

format.description: Format of the output. Options: wkt, geojson-bbox, leaflet, overpass, ogc-bbox, kml, geojson-polygon, csv, stac-bbox. Default: csv.

coord_order.description: Toggle between 'lng,lat' (default) and 'lat,lng' coordinate ordering in the formatted output. Useful for APIs that expect swapped coordinate orders.

zoom.description: The map zoom level (0-22) used to calculate the map tile coordinates for the centroid. Defaults to 15.

precision.description: The number of decimal places to output coordinate strings as (defaults to 6).

tools.name: get_h3_indices
tools.description: Get Uber H3 cell indices for a polygon (including interior holes), location boundary, or bounding box at a target resolution. When a WKT/GeoJSON polygon or named location boundary is provided, fills the exact polygon geometry (subtracting interior holes) rather than just its bounding rectangle.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'San Francisco'). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), WKT polygon (with optional holes), GeoJSON polygon/multipolygon, tile 'z/x/y', or ogrinfo extent. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

resolution.description: The H3 resolution level, from 0 to 15. (e.g. 7)

compact.description: Whether to return a compacted list of cells (mixing resolutions) to minimize response size. Defaults to false.

summary_only.description: If true, returns only cell count, sample cells, and map share URL without dumping thousands of cell IDs into context. Ideal for high resolutions. Defaults to false.

return_geometry.description: If true, return GeoJSON FeatureCollection with hex boundary polygons in addition to cell IDs. Defaults to false.

use_polygon_boundary.description: If true (default), fills the exact WKT/GeoJSON/OSM polygon boundary (including interior holes) instead of its rectangular bounding box when available.

tools.name: generate_share_url
tools.description: Generates a URL that links to the visual Bounding Box tool to display these coordinates on a map. Supports WKT, GeoJSON, ogrinfo extent, tile 'z/x/y', and raw coordinate strings as input.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), WKT, GeoJSON, tile 'z/x/y', or ogrinfo extent.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Reverse geocode latitude and longitude coordinates to discover context, place name, address components, and OSM details ('what is here?').

zoom.description: Detail zoom level from 0 (country) to 18 (building/address). Defaults to 18.

tools.name: search_overpass
tools.description:
Execute an Overpass QL query to find POIs, roads, or other OSM features within an admin boundary area, bounding box, or radius. The server wraps your query in spatial filters, detects Overpass runtime errors, and returns structured JSON with provenance, completeness metadata, distance calculations, and a map link.

SEARCH MODES:
- Location / Admin Area: when 'location' resolves to an OSM boundary polygon (e.g. 'Manhattan', 'Seattle'), searches inside exact boundary polygon.
- Bounding box (default): searches a rectangular area.
- Circle: searches within an exact radius when 'radius_meters' is provided.
- Fast Count: set 'count_only: true' to get instant element counts without downloading full element payloads.

COMMON TAG EXAMPLES:
- Restaurants: `nwr["amenity"="restaurant"]`
- Pizza: `nwr["amenity"="fast_food"]["cuisine"="pizza"]`
- Supermarkets: `nwr["shop"="supermarket"]`
- Parks: `nwr["leisure"="park"]`
- Hospitals: `nwr["amenity"="hospital"]`
- EV Charging: `nwr["amenity"="charging_station"]`
- Gyms: `nwr["leisure"="fitness_centre"]`
- Banks: `nwr["amenity"="bank"]`

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'Manhattan', 'San Francisco'). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

query.description: The Overpass QL core query. Example: `node["amenity"="cafe"]` or `nwr["leisure"="park"]`. Multi-statement queries supported (e.g. `nwr["office"="coworking"]; nwr["amenity"="coworking_space"]`). DO NOT include spatial filters or output directives.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in metres. Enables circle mode — use ONLY when explicit distance is specified ('2km' → 2000).

limit.description: Maximum number of elements to return per page. Default is 100.

offset.description: Pagination offset for retrieving subsequent pages of results. Default is 0.

timeout_seconds.description: Overpass server query timeout in seconds. Default is 25.

use_area_boundary.description: If true (default), uses exact OSM administrative boundary polygon for named locations when available, avoiding bounding box collapse.

sort_by_distance.description: If true, sorts returned elements by distance from origin/center. Enabled by default for circle mode and point locations.

return_geometry.description: If true, returns full geometry (polygon/polyline) for ways and relations instead of center point. Defaults to false.

count_only.description: If true, executes an ultra-fast Overpass 'out count;' query and returns total counts (nodes, ways, relations, total) without downloading individual features. Defaults to false.

tools.name: list_osm_tags
tools.description: Discovery tool to look up the correct OpenStreetMap tags for any category. Uses built-in category index and live Taginfo API fallback to prevent tag hallucination.

category.description: Category or keyword to look up (e.g. 'food', 'ev charging', 'gym', 'coworking', 'banks', 'dog park').

tools.name: aggregate_overpass_h3
tools.description: Executes an Overpass query and bins the results into H3 hexagons at a specified resolution to analyze spatial density. Plots the top density hotspots on the shareable verification map.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'Seattle').

bbox.description: The bounding box geometry to parse.

resolution.description: The H3 resolution level (0-15) for binning. Default is 8.

radius_meters.description: Optional search radius in metres around the location/bbox center.

timeout_seconds.description: Overpass server query timeout in seconds. Default is 25.

use_area_boundary.description: If true (default), uses exact OSM boundary polygon for named locations when available.

tools.name: calculate_route
tools.description: Calculate real-world travel distance, duration, turn-by-turn summary (with maneuver coordinates), GeoJSON route geometry, and route bounding box between two locations or coordinate pairs using OpenStreetMap routing (FOSSGIS / OSRM, or configurable OSRM_API_URL). Supports optional intermediate 'waypoints' and requesting 'alternatives' (up to 3 OSRM routes for side-by-side comparison with check_traffic_controls).

origin.description: Starting point as 'lat,lng' coordinates (e.g. '40.7128,-74.0060') or a natural-language place name (e.g. 'Times Square, NYC').

destination.description: Ending point as 'lat,lng' coordinates (e.g. '40.6413,-73.7781') or a natural-language place name (e.g. 'JFK Airport').

waypoints.description: Optional list of intermediate via-points ('lat,lng' or place names, up to 20) to force the route through specific streets or intersections.

profile.description: Travel mode profile: 'driving' (car), 'walking' (foot), or 'cycling' (bicycle). Defaults to 'driving'.

return_steps.description: If true, includes step-by-step road names, maneuver instructions, and turn coordinates. Defaults to false.

alternatives.description: If true, requests up to 3 alternative routes from OSRM (only supported when 'waypoints' is empty). Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_elevation
tools.description: Query terrain elevation in meters above sea level using the Open-Meteo 90m Copernicus DEM API (free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a paid key or self-hosted ELEVATION_API_URL). Supports querying specific point coordinates OR sampling an N×N point grid across a bounding box to compute sample statistics (note: finite grid sampling over a 90m DEM reports sample statistics, not guaranteed area-wide true minimum, maximum, or slope).

points.description: List of {lat, lng, label?} points to query elevation for (up to 100 points).

location.description: A text location to sample elevation across (e.g. 'Mount Rainier', 'Denver').

bbox.description: A bounding box or point string to sample terrain elevation across.

grid_size.description: Grid dimension N (N x N samples, from 2 to 10) when sampling a bounding box. Defaults to 5 (25 sample points).

tools.name: spatial_calc
tools.description: Perform deterministic offline geometric calculations on bounding boxes, points, and polygons (with holes, zero network calls): 'relation' (intersects, contains, overlap area %, union & intersection bbox between two geometries), 'point_in_geometry' (check if a point is inside a bbox or WKT/GeoJSON polygon respecting interior holes), 'distance_bearing' (exact Haversine distance, initial compass bearing, and midpoint between two points), or 'split_grid' (subdivide a bbox into an N x M grid of sub-bboxes for chunked queries).

bbox_a.description: First geometry / bounding box (for 'relation', 'point_in_geometry', 'split_grid') or origin point 'lat,lng' (for 'distance_bearing').

bbox_b.description: Second geometry / bounding box (for 'relation') or destination point 'lat,lng' (for 'distance_bearing').

rows.description: Number of latitude rows for 'split_grid' (1-20, default 2).

cols.description: Number of longitude columns for 'split_grid' (1-20, default 2).

tools.name: check_traffic_controls
tools.description:
Check OpenStreetMap for traffic signals (traffic lights) and stop signs at a junction, within a radius of a coordinate/place, across a bounding box/area, or along a route corridor. Returns explicit booleans (has_traffic_signal, has_stop_sign), junction classification (control_type: 'traffic_signals' | 'stop_sign' | 'both' | 'none'), separate counts, exact coordinates, and a shareable verification map.

MODES:
- Junction / Coordinate: pass a point in 'bbox' (e.g. '40.7580,-73.9855') with optional 'radius_meters' (defaults to 35m).
- Bounding box / Area: pass a bbox or 'location' (without 'radius_meters') to count or list all traffic signals and stop signs inside.
- Route corridor (by endpoints): pass 'origin' and 'destination' (plus optional 'profile': driving/walking/cycling) to route via OSRM and inspect traffic controls along the route in one call.
- Route corridor (by geometry): pass 'route_geometry' (the GeoJSON LineString from calculate_route) with optional 'radius_meters' (defaults to 20m) to evaluate traffic signals and stop signs along a route in travel order.

location.description: A text location or intersection to check (e.g. 'Manhattan', '5th Ave and 42nd St, New York'). Provide 'location', 'bbox', 'route_geometry', or 'origin'+'destination'.

bbox.description: Point 'lat,lng', bounding box 'lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2', WKT, GeoJSON, tile 'z/x/y', or ogrinfo extent. For a single point, 'radius_meters' defaults to 35m if omitted.

origin.description: Route origin ('lat,lng' or place name) when evaluating traffic controls directly between two points. Must be paired with 'destination'.

destination.description: Route destination ('lat,lng' or place name) when evaluating traffic controls directly between two points. Must be paired with 'origin'.

profile.description: Routing profile when using 'origin' and 'destination': 'driving' (default), 'walking', or 'cycling'.

route_geometry.description: GeoJSON LineString ({ type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[lng, lat], ...] }) from calculate_route to find traffic signals and stop signs along a route corridor.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters. Enables circle mode around a point/location (defaults to 35m for a single point) or corridor width around a route (defaults to 20m).

include_crossings.description: If true, also treats signalized pedestrian crossings (highway=crossing with crossing=traffic_signals or crossing:signals=yes) as traffic signals. Defaults to false.

count_only.description: If true, returns presence booleans and counts without individual feature coordinates. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum total elements to return across traffic_signals and stop_signs when count_only is false. Default is 200 (max 1000).

offset.description: Pagination offset when count_only is false. Default is 0.

timeout_seconds.description: Overpass server query timeout in seconds. Default is 25.

use_area_boundary.description: If true (default), uses exact OSM administrative boundary polygon for named locations when available.
